milestone_invoice_pair.name: milestone_invoice_pair
milestone_invoice_pair.value: ("fee_milestones"."invoice_number" is null and "fee_milestones"."invoice_date" is null) or (length(trim("fee_milestones"."invoice_number")) > 0 and "fee_milestones"."invoice_number" is not null and "fee_milestones"."invoice_date" is not null)

schedule_planned_order.name: schedule_planned_order
schedule_planned_order.value: "phase_schedules"."planned_start" is null or "phase_schedules"."planned_end" is null or "phase_schedules"."planned_end" >= "phase_schedules"."planned_start"

schedule_actual_order.name: schedule_actual_order
schedule_actual_order.value: "phase_schedules"."actual_end" is null or ("phase_schedules"."actual_start" is not null and "phase_schedules"."actual_end" >= "phase_schedules"."actual_start")

decision_date_matches_status.name: decision_date_matches_status
decision_date_matches_status.value: ("project_decisions"."status" = 'Pending' and "project_decisions"."decision_date" is null) or ("project_decisions"."status" <> 'Pending' and "project_decisions"."decision_date" is not null)

deliverable_completion_date.name: deliverable_completion_date
deliverable_completion_date.value: ("project_deliverables"."completed" and "project_deliverables"."completed_at" is not null) or (not "project_deliverables"."completed" and "project_deliverables"."completed_at" is null)

deliverable_template_pair.name: deliverable_template_pair
deliverable_template_pair.value: ("project_deliverables"."template_key" is null and "project_deliverables"."template_item_key" is null) or ("project_deliverables"."template_key" is not null and "project_deliverables"."template_item_key" is not null)
